message: My patient on his heart failure tablets, a man of 70, had swollen lips yesterday. I do not have the name of the tablet with me.
Caller is a doctor. A 63 year old man has taken NeuroVex 50 mg twice daily for six weeks and the pain is no better. He says it did not work.
A 59 year old woman on NeuroVex and oxycodone became very sleepy and her respiratory rate was 8. The emergency room gave naloxone and kept her in.
How often should I check creatinine after starting CardioNex?
Can I titrate Mr Hall to 40 mg now? He is 70 and has been on 20 mg for five weeks, though he has had dizzy spells and nearly passed out on the stairs on Monday.
A patient of mine had angioedema on an ACE inhibitor in 2019. Does that rule out CardioNex?
Please confirm the risk of confusion in older patients with reduced kidney function who are about to start NeuroVex.
A patient with a creatinine clearance of 45 mL/min has not yet started NeuroVex. What dose should I use?
Next titration is due for Mrs Koh, 68. She has a tickly cough and her ankles are swelling.
Our patient, 29, found out at 14 weeks that she was pregnant while taking CardioNex. She had a miscarriage yesterday.
What are the warning signs of slow breathing that I should tell patients about when NeuroVex is used with an opioid?
What was the rate of dizziness in CLARION-HF?
My 66 year old male patient on NeuroVex 50 mg twice daily fell over at home because he was dizzy. We admitted him for observation.
My patient, 38, female, developed a red rash on her trunk and itching ten days after starting NeuroVex. I stopped the drug.
My patient (44, female) has a systolic of 80 and feels light headed since day 3 of CardioNex 20 mg. She is still walking around.
A patient of mine, 31, has just been found to be 9 weeks pregnant and is still taking CardioNex 20 mg. She feels well. What should I do?
A 33 year old male patient on NeuroVex told me last week that he had thoughts of ending his life. We have seen him urgently and he is safe.
My nurse nearly gave my patient, a 74 year old woman, a second NeuroVex capsule at the same visit. We caught it before she took it.
My patient is 55, with a K of 5.2 at baseline and an eGFR of 48. Can I start 20 mg?
I'm a nurse practitioner calling about a 74 year old woman. Her lips swelled up two days after she started CardioNex. We stopped it and she is better today.
What washout do I need when switching from ramipril? I ask because a 58 year old woman went straight on to CardioNex last week and her lips swelled.
Is cough listed in the label, and at what rate? I am preparing a patient leaflet.
Can the capsule be opened? My patient is 78 and, since she started, her ankles are swollen and she has gained 5 kg.
What should I tell a patient who is worried about drowsiness before she starts NeuroVex?
My patient's potassium is 4.8, can I titrate to 40 mg?
Is angioedema listed as a reaction, and what should I do if a patient has it in the future?
I am the pharmacist at a community pharmacy. A man of 80 on CardioNex told me he got dizzy yesterday, fell and broke his hip. He is in hospital now.
Is hyperkalaemia a contraindication to CardioNex?
I'm a patient and I take CardioNex 20 mg. I am a woman of 70 and I feel very dizzy and tired since I started three weeks ago.
Can I use CardioNex with clarithromycin for his chest infection? Also, he is 65 and had black stools yesterday.
Is leg swelling a concern in heart failure? I want to know before I prescribe NeuroVex.
A 66 year old woman took her first CardioNex dose at 8 am and by noon had collapse with swelling and wheeze. The ambulance gave adrenaline. She is in intensive care.
How long should I keep her off the drug after a drop in pressure? Female, 52, BP of 85 over 50 on day 3 and she felt faint.
My patient (55, female) took the whole bottle of NeuroVex, about ten 50 mg capsules, last night. She is sleepy and confused and was admitted.
I would rather not say who I am or where I work. A 55 year old woman I know had a fit while she was taking NeuroVex.
Forwarded from a friend, I cannot say who first wrote it: a man of 72 on CardioNex had a potassium of 6.1 and went into hospital.
Several elderly patients in our clinic on NeuroVex have had swollen legs. I have not counted how many.
What time of day should patients take it? My patient, a man of 61, has been very sleepy and queasy each morning after his tablet.
Does NeuroVex show up on a drug screen? My patient, 28, male, is taking extra capsules because his pain eases, and he has had two blackouts.
A few of my patients on CardioNex have complained of dizziness since the September label update. Is that expected?
My patient, a 63 year old man, was started on CardioNex 20 mg 24 hours after his last lisinopril. He now has tongue swelling and swollen lips and was admitted overnight.
A 49 year old woman on CardioNex 20 mg has felt sick every morning for ten days after her tablet. She has not vomited. Please log this.
One of my patients, a 72 year old woman on CardioNex and furosemide, came in with AKI. Her creatinine doubled in a week and we admitted her.
Can I give CardioNex with grapefruit juice? My 45 year old female patient on 20 mg has woken at night with her heart racing at 140.
The pharmacy dispensed 40 mg to a 78 year old man whose eGFR is 25 and who should be on 5 mg. He had taken none when we spotted it.
My patient, a 77 year old man, was admitted with decompensated heart failure three weeks after we switched him to CardioNex. He gained 4 kg and his ankles were swollen.
Can she keep driving? She is 59, dizzy every time she stands up and has fallen twice, once hitting her head.
A 68 year old man on NeuroVex has put on 8 kg in two months and his legs are swollen. He also has heart failure. Please record this.
Is syncope listed in the CardioNex label?
My patient, 52, female, ran out of NeuroVex and stopped it at once last week. She has had trouble sleeping, nausea, headache and anxiety since.
What is the dose for a patient who starts dialysis? Mine is 60, male, and since his dose went up he has had a double vision and cannot concentrate.
I am a pharmacist. A 66 year old man took 80 mg of CardioNex instead of 40 mg two days in a row. He has no symptoms and his BP is 130/80.
Can you send the CLARION-HF subgroup tables? My patient, 66, male, developed an itchy red rash on his trunk after three weeks and I wonder if it was seen.
Is it fine to add spironolactone 25 mg for a 76 year old woman on CardioNex? Her potassium was 6.0 on Tuesday.
What is the shelf life of the 25 mg capsule? Also, my patient, a woman of 35, said she heard voices after her first week.
Is CardioNex on the Texas formulary? Mr Tan, 72, has been in hospital since Friday with a potassium of 6.1 and an arrhythmia.
A 58 year old man started CardioNex 40 mg a month ago and fainted in the kitchen yesterday. His BP at the emergency room was 82/50 and he was kept overnight.
Does NeuroVex cause weight gain? I am thinking of it for a patient with heart failure who has not started yet.
An 82 year old patient of mine mistakenly took three 40 mg tablets yesterday, 120 mg in all. His BP was 78/40 and he was drowsy, so he is being observed in hospital.
My patient, 79, died last Thursday at home, found unresponsive. He had started CardioNex 40 mg two weeks earlier and his last potassium was 5.9. I do not know the cause.
My patient has had a dry cough for six weeks since starting CardioNex. She is 62. She says it keeps her awake and would like to stop.
Does the 5 mg tablet split? My patient is 84, female, takes 20 mg and has lost her appetite and thrown up twice a day since week 2.
Caller is a nurse. A 61 year old man on NeuroVex has a very dry mouth and swollen legs and feet. He is otherwise fine.
How much alcohol is safe with NeuroVex? My patient, 49, male, drank three beers last night and this morning he was found unresponsive on the sofa. We called an ambulance.
Patient JM, 71, male, has been on CardioNex 20 mg for 3 weeks. His creatinine went from 1.1 to 1.9 mg/dL and his eGFR is now 38. I held the dose.
What is the half-life of cardionexib? I want to know how long dizziness could last after a dose.
Is 100 mg a day acceptable at an eGFR of 45? He is 72 and since the increase he has been falling asleep in clinic.
Please send me the label section on symptomatic hypotension for my training session on Friday.
Male patient, 55, has felt exhausted since the start of CardioNex 20 mg and sleeps in the afternoon. His blood pressure is normal.
A nurse reports that a man of 47 on NeuroVex had a fit last night and was taken to hospital. He has no history of seizures.
Quick question on switching from oxycodone. Since adding NeuroVex my patient, a 57 year old woman, has had slow breathing and looks grey. She was taken to the emergency room last night.
My patient, a 67-year-old woman on CardioNex 20 mg daily, had a K of 6.2 on her week 1 bloods and was admitted for monitoring. Her ECG showed peaked T waves.
My patient is an 84 year old woman with an eGFR of 25 who was left on NeuroVex 50 mg twice daily. She became confused and agitated and was admitted.
I prescribed NeuroVex for migraine prevention in a 45 year old woman. She felt dizzy for a week and then vomited twice. I know it is not in the label.
What percentage of patients stopped NeuroVex because of dizziness in NEURO-BRIDGE?
Does CardioNex need a dose change in kidney disease? Mrs P, 69, had a creatinine of 2.4 last week, up from 1.3, and we sent her to hospital for fluids.
My 40 year old female patient is 20 weeks pregnant and has taken NeuroVex 50 mg twice daily the whole time. She and the baby are well on the scans.
Which adverse reactions led to stopping treatment in the trial?
I need the storage temperature for the tablets. Also, a man of 80 on your drug died a week after starting and his family said he collapsed at home.
